+++ b/packages/query-core/src/__tests__/persisterRestore.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,215 @@
+import { describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import {
+  QueryCache,
+  QueryClient,
+  QueryObserver,
+  createPersisterRestoreResult,
+  hydrate,
+} from '../index'
+import type { QueryState } from '../index'
+
+describe('persister restore behavior', () => {
+  test('single-query restore with createPersisterRestoreResult preserves full state and does not trigger onSuccess/onSettled', async () => {
+    const onSuccessSpy = vi.fn()
+    const onSettledSpy = vi.fn()
+    const queryClient = new QueryClient({
+      queryCache: new QueryCache({
+        onSuccess: onSuccessSpy,
+        onSettled: onSettledSpy,
+      }),
+    })
+
+    const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+      data: 'persisted data',
+      dataUpdateCount: 3,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      error: new Error('persisted error'),
+      errorUpdateCount: 2,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 1500,
+      fetchFailureCount: 4,
+      fetchFailureReason: new Error('persisted error'),
+      fetchMeta: null,
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      isInvalidated: true,
+      status: 'error',
+    }
+
+    const persister = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(
+      createPersisterRestoreResult({
+        data: persistedState.data,
+        state: persistedState,
+      }),
+    )
+
+    const observer = new QueryObserver(queryClient, {
+      queryKey: ['persistedQuery'],
+      queryFn: () => Promise.resolve('fresh data'),
+      persister,
+    })
+
+    await observer.refetch()
+
+    const result = observer.getCurrentResult()
+
+    expect(result.data).toBe('persisted data')
+    expect(result.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(result.isError).toBe(true)
+    expect(result.isRefetchError).toBe(true)
+    expect(result.error).toEqual(new Error('persisted error'))
+    expect(result.failureCount).toBe(4)
+    expect(result.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(1000)
+    expect(result.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(1500)
+    expect(result.isStale).toBe(true)
+    expect(result.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+
+    expect(onSuccessSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(onSettledSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  test('single-query restore preserves infinite query pagination state', async () => {
+    const queryClient = new QueryClient()
+
+    const persistedData = {
+      pages: ['page 1', 'page 2'],
+      pageParams: [null, 1],
+    }
+
+    const persistedState: Partial<QueryState> = {
+      data: persistedData,
+      dataUpdatedAt: 2000,
+      status: 'success',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    }
+
+    const persister = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(
+      createPersisterRestoreResult({
+        data: persistedData,
+        state: persistedState,
+      }),
+    )
+
+    const observer = new QueryObserver(queryClient, {
+      queryKey: ['infiniteQuery'],
+      queryFn: () => Promise.resolve({ pages: [], pageParams: [] }),
+      persister,
+    })
+
+    await observer.refetch()
+
+    const result = observer.getCurrentResult()
+
+    expect(result.data).toEqual(persistedData)
+    expect(result.status).toBe('success')
+  })
+
+  test('reconciliation: live cache has newer data but persisted snapshot has newer error', () => {
+    const queryClient = new QueryClient()
+
+    // Create live query in cache with newer data
+    const query = queryClient.getQueryCache().build(queryClient, {
+      queryKey: ['reconcile1'],
+    })
+    query.setState({
+      data: 'live newer data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 2000,
+      dataUpdateCount: 2,
+      error: null,
+      errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+      status: 'success',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    })
+
+    // Hydrate with persisted snapshot having older data but newer error
+    hydrate(queryClient, {
+      queries: [
+        {
+          queryHash: query.queryHash,
+          queryKey: query.queryKey,
+          state: {
+            data: 'persisted older data',
+            dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+            dataUpdateCount: 1,
+            error: new Error('persisted newer error'),
+            errorUpdatedAt: 2500,
+            errorUpdateCount: 1,
+            fetchFailureCount: 3,
+            fetchFailureReason: new Error('persisted newer error'),
+            fetchMeta: null,
+            status: 'error',
+            fetchStatus: 'idle',
+          } as QueryState,
+        },
+      ],
+    })
+
+    const observer = new QueryObserver(queryClient, {
+      queryKey: ['reconcile1'],
+    })
+    const result = observer.getCurrentResult()
+
+    expect(result.data).toBe('live newer data')
+    expect(result.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+    expect(result.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(result.error).toEqual(new Error('persisted newer error'))
+    expect(result.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(2500)
+    expect(result.failureCount).toBe(3)
+    expect(result.isRefetchError).toBe(true)
+  })
+
+  test('reconciliation: live cache has newer error but persisted snapshot has newer data', () => {
+    const queryClient = new QueryClient()
+
+    // Create live query in cache with newer error
+    const query = queryClient.getQueryCache().build(queryClient, {
+      queryKey: ['reconcile2'],
+    })
+    query.setState({
+      data: 'live older data',
+      dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+      dataUpdateCount: 1,
+      error: new Error('live newer error'),
+      errorUpdatedAt: 2500,
+      errorUpdateCount: 1,
+      fetchFailureCount: 2,
+      fetchFailureReason: new Error('live newer error'),
+      status: 'error',
+      fetchStatus: 'idle',
+    })
+
+    // Hydrate with persisted snapshot having newer data but older/no error
+    hydrate(queryClient, {
+      queries: [
+        {
+          queryHash: query.queryHash,
+          queryKey: query.queryKey,
+          state: {
+            data: 'persisted newer data',
+            dataUpdatedAt: 2000,
+            dataUpdateCount: 2,
+            error: null,
+            errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+            errorUpdateCount: 0,
+            fetchFailureCount: 0,
+            fetchFailureReason: null,
+            fetchMeta: null,
+            status: 'success',
+            fetchStatus: 'idle',
+          } as QueryState,
+        },
+      ],
+    })
+
+    const observer = new QueryObserver(queryClient, {
+      queryKey: ['reconcile2'],
+    })
+    const result = observer.getCurrentResult()
+
+    expect(result.data).toBe('persisted newer data')
+    expect(result.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+    expect(result.status).toBe('error')
+    expect(result.error).toEqual(new Error('live newer error'))
+    expect(result.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(2500)
+    expect(result.failureCount).toBe(2)
+    expect(result.isRefetchError).toBe(true)
+  })
+})

+const persisterRestoreResultSymbol = Symbol('persisterRestoreResultMarker')
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+> {
+  [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]: true
+  data?: TData
+  state?: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>>
+}
+
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(result: {
+  data?: TData
+  state?: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>>
+}): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return {
+    [persisterRestoreResultSymbol]: true,
+    data: result.data,
+    state: result.state,
+  }
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult(
+  value: unknown,
+): value is PersisterRestoreResult {
+  return (
+    typeof value === 'object' &&
+    value !== null &&
+    (value as any)[persisterRestoreResultSymbol] === true
+  )
+}
